QuestInfo.name: [Red Leaf High] Chapter 3: Ghost in the Music Room
QuestInfo.1: There is a story about a girl from Red Leaf High who loved the piano. The girl played the piano every day after school in the music room and one day she fell asleep because she was too tired. That night, the caretaker without knowing that the girl had fallen asleep had locked the classroom.  And on the next day after realizing the girl was missing, the people opened up the doors to the classroom to find something shocking. There was no trace of the girl but only distinct nail marks left on the doors to the music room. She must tried to claw her way out because she was so scared. People looked for her everywhere in the school but she was nowhere to be found. After that day, every night, sound of piano being played in the music room can be heard but because the piano sounds are so horrible, they are frightening. The  Sheet Music of the girl have to be taken away so that the frightening music can be stopped from being played.

0.0: #b#h0##k, have you been to the music room lately? It's awful. I was heading to the music room the other day and I heard some noise. I think the haunted stories about the room are true...\r\n#L0##bWhat do you mean?#l\n#k
0.1: You haven't heard? There was once a girl who loved pianos. She practiced playing piano everyday in the music room, but she dozed off in one of her practice sessions. She woke up when it was already late at night. All the doors were locked and no one else was at the school. People realized that the girl was missing on the following day, so when they rushed to the #r#emusic room...#n\r\n#L0##bWhat happened?#l\n#k
0.2: The girl wasn't there. She disappeared like the wind. No one saw her around afterwards either.\r\n#L0##bAre you sure that the girl wasn't in the music room to begin with? Maybe she just ran away.#l\n#k
0.3: No! The girl wasn't in the room yes, but she was DEFINITELY in the room. The poor little girl was terrified to be locked up alone in the school...her #e#rbloody scratch marks were found on the music room door...#k#n\r\n#L0##bTha...that's terrifying...#l\n#k
0.4: That's even more terrifying is that every night there's a sound of the piano playing from the music room. People say that it's the ghost of the girl playing the girl in the empty music room. She...#e#breally sucked at playing piano you see.#k#n\nI heard such noise last night. I've never had such displeasure hearing piano before in my life. At this rate, no one else will be able to even approach the music room. #b#h0##k! Can you go to the music room and take away the music sheet so that the girl ghost can never play the piano again!?

yes.0: I feel sorry for the girl, but I'd really rather not hear her play again. Her song will drive me insane and it'll disrupt other classes. Please, help us. \r\n#b#eDoor on the right#k#n will take you to the music room.
